name: Camp Whitin
description_short: Weekly co-ed day camps run by the Whitin Community Center in Whitinsville, MA, for ages 4-13. Children ages 7-13 choose a sport or activity camp with daily swimming in the WCC pool, and children ages 4-6 attend Mini camps. Camp runs 9:00am-3:00pm, Monday-Friday, with time outdoors in the 7.5-acre Whitin Park.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers ages 7-13 can swim daily in the WCC Competition Pool. Mini camps (ages 4-6) do not swim.

refund_policy_summary: A $50 non-refundable deposit per camp week holds a space. Cancel by May 1 for a full refund minus the $50 deposit per week and a $25 processing fee; after that, a 75% refund (minus the same) only for a documented medical reason with at least 1 day's notice. Deposits are never refunded.
